fields.runs_dir: parent directory recursively scanned (rglob) by TensorboardRunSelector for run subdirectories whose tensorboard_dirname holds event files
fields.run_filter: exact run names or run-dir relative paths selecting which runs under runs_dir to export; a trial directory name expands to every seed run nested beneath it, empty triggers interactive selection on a tty, else all runs
fields.tensorboard_dirname: name of the subdirectory inside each run directory that holds the tensorboard event files, forwarded to each run's TensorboardExportConfig
fields.output_subdir: subdirectory name inside each run directory where that run's exported figures are written, forwarded to each run's TensorboardExportConfig

diagnostics::ReportCollectionConfig.summary: Per-run report collection: locates the run's inference report(s), rewrites every image link to an absolute path into the original figures (or embeds them as base64 data for a self-contained file), and writes the result into the collector directory renamed after the run

fields.run_directory: training run directory whose inference outputs hold the report(s) to collect
fields.collector_dir: directory that receives the collected report, named <run>.md (latest_only) or <run>_<inference tag>.md
fields.inference_dirname: name of the subdirectory inside the run directory that holds the timestamped inference outputs, defaults to inference
fields.report_filename: report filename inside each inference output directory, defaults to report.md
fields.latest_only: collect only the report of the latest inference output (by directory name); when false every inference report is collected with the inference tag appended to the name
fields.embed_images: embed referenced images as base64 data URIs so the collected report is fully self-contained; off by default because reports can reference hundreds of figures, in which case links are rewritten to absolute paths into the original run

diagnostics::ReportCollectionEntryConfig.summary: Batch webui entry selecting training runs with inference reports and building a per-run ReportCollectionConfig via to_config; nested seed runs are labelled <trial>_seed<N>, and a missing referenced image or two selected runs sharing a label abort the collection loudly

fields.runs_dir: parent directory recursively scanned (rglob) by ReportRunSelector for run subdirectories whose inference_dirname holds a report
fields.run_filter: exact run names or run-dir relative paths selecting which runs under runs_dir to collect; a trial directory name expands to every seed run nested beneath it, empty triggers interactive selection on a tty, else all runs
fields.collector_dir: single directory that receives every collected report, created if missing; re-collection overwrites previous copies
fields.inference_dirname: name of the subdirectory inside each run directory that holds the timestamped inference outputs, forwarded to each run's ReportCollectionConfig
fields.report_filename: report filename inside each inference output directory, forwarded to each run's ReportCollectionConfig
fields.latest_only: collect only each run's latest inference report; when false every inference report is collected with the inference tag appended to the name
fields.embed_images: embed referenced images as base64 data URIs so each collected report is fully self-contained instead of linking back to the original run figures

diagnostics::ExperimentReportMailConfig.summary: Gathering settings of one experiment's mail bundle: the staging directory, the comparison layout, the inference report layout, the regeneration switch and the image embedding mode

fields.staging_dir: directory that receives this experiment's gathered files; re-gathering overwrites previous copies
fields.comparison_dirname: name of the subdirectory inside the experiment holding the timestamped trial-comparison outputs, defaults to _comparison
fields.comparison_reports: report filenames gathered from the newest comparison stamp; a missing one aborts the gathering loudly
fields.inference_dirname: name of the subdirectory inside a trial that holds the timestamped inference outputs, defaults to inference
fields.report_filename: report filename inside each inference output directory, defaults to report.md
fields.regenerate_reports: whether the seed aggregates, the trial comparison and a cross-validation run's cross-fold report are rewritten even when present
fields.embed_images: embed referenced images as base64 data URIs so each gathered report is fully self-contained instead of linking back to the original figures by absolute path

diagnostics::ArtifactMailConfig.summary: Per-source artifact gathering for a dataset, a parameter-extraction run or a training run: resolves the three path lists against the source directory, drops whatever the exclusion rules leave out, packs the rest into deflate archives that each stay under the attachment cap, and keeps the source tree inside them so unpacking every archive into one folder rebuilds it

fields.source_dir: dataset folder, parameter-extraction run folder or training run folder whose artifacts are packed
fields.staging_dir: directory that receives this source's archives; re-gathering deletes the archives of the previous run first
fields.label: identity of the source in the subject line and the root folder every archived file sits under, also the stem of the archive filenames with the slash replaced by a double underscore
fields.required_paths: paths relative to the source directory that must exist, each a file or a directory whose whole subtree is taken; a missing one aborts the gathering loudly
fields.optional_paths: paths relative to the source directory attached when present, each a file or a directory whose whole subtree is taken; a missing one only warns
fields.analysis_paths: paths written by the analysis entry, attached when present; when none of them exist the source has not been analysed and one warning names the entry to run
fields.analysis_entry: name of the analysis entry that writes the analysis paths, quoted in the warning raised when none of them exist
fields.excluded_paths: globs of content never packed, matched against a file's path relative to the source directory, against each of its parent directories and against the bare name of each of them, so 'cubes' drops a directory of that name wherever it sits while 'inference/*/cubes' drops only the ones inside an inference stamp
fields.excluded_suffixes: file extensions never packed, matched case-insensitively against the file name, .pt for the checkpoints and .npy for the arrays among them
fields.max_file_mb: upper bound of one packed file in megabytes, above which the file is left out and named in the left-out table; zero turns the size rule off and packs every file the other two rules keep
fields.max_attachment_mb: upper bound of one archive in megabytes, measured on the uncompressed sources; keep it under the mail server limit with room for the roughly one third that base64 encoding adds on the wire

diagnostics::ReportMailEntryConfig.summary: Entry config of the report mailer: picks one of four targets (experiments, runs, datasets, param_extraction), names the path each target scans and how each source is gathered, and carries the shared SMTP settings, the staging directory and the attachment size cap

fields.target: which source the run mails: experiments (sweeps of trial runs, cross-validation runs and benchmark runs found at or below experiments_dir), runs (the content of the training runs found at or below runs_dir), datasets (generated datasets) or param_extraction (fitted parameter runs); only that target's root, filter and gathered paths are read
fields.experiments_dir: path searched for experiments at or below it: a sweep directory of trial runs, a cross-validation run (or its folds directory), a benchmark run (or its training directory), a sequence workspace holding several of them, or a whole runs tree; experiments are recognised by the trial runs they hold, never by their names, and the scan stops at each one so run trees are never entered
fields.experiment_filter: experiment paths relative to experiments_dir, or experiment names, restricting the mailing; empty mails every experiment found
fields.comparison_dirname: name of the subdirectory inside each sweep holding the timestamped trial-comparison outputs, where a missing comparison is written before mailing
fields.comparison_reports: report filenames gathered from the newest trial-comparison stamp of a sweep or cross-validation run (a benchmark run always contributes benchmark_overview.md and metrics_comparison.md from its own comparison); a missing one aborts
fields.inference_dirname: name of the subdirectory inside a trial that holds the timestamped inference outputs, forwarded to each experiment's ExperimentReportMailConfig
fields.report_filename: report filename inside each inference output directory, forwarded to each experiment's ExperimentReportMailConfig
fields.regenerate_reports: whether every selected experiment gets its seed-aggregate reports, its trial comparison and, for a cross-validation run, its cross-fold report rewritten even when they exist; off writes only the ones that are missing
fields.embed_images: embed referenced images as base64 data URIs so each gathered report is fully self-contained instead of linking back to the original figures by absolute path
fields.runs_dir: path searched for training runs at or below it, a whole runs tree, one family directory, a sweep or a single run; a run is recognised by the meta directory it holds and is never descended into, so the seed runs of a trial are offered as the separate runs they are
fields.run_filter: run paths relative to runs_dir, or run names, restricting the mailing; empty triggers interactive selection on a tty, else every run found
fields.run_excluded_paths: globs of a run's content never mailed, matched against a file's path relative to the run, against each of its parent directories and against the bare name of each of them; the default drops the checkpoints directory and every cubes directory, wherever they sit
fields.run_excluded_suffixes: file extensions of a run's content never mailed; the default drops the checkpoints (.pt, .pth, .ckpt) and the arrays (.npy, .npz, .h5, .pkl), which is everything that runs to hundreds of megabytes
fields.run_max_file_mb: upper bound of one mailed file of a run in megabytes, above which it is left out and named in the left-out table; the default of 5 keeps every figure and leaves the walk animations behind, and zero mails every file the two exclusion lists keep
fields.datasets_dir: root directory holding one folder per generated dataset; only direct children carrying a data/dataset.json layout are offered
fields.dataset_filter: exact dataset folder names selecting which datasets to mail; empty triggers interactive selection on a tty, else all datasets
fields.dataset_required_paths: dataset generation outputs that must exist in a dataset, each a file or a directory whose whole subtree is attached; a missing one aborts that dataset loudly
fields.dataset_optional_paths: dataset generation outputs attached when present; a missing one only warns. The arrays under data/ are deliberately absent from the default: they run to hundreds of megabytes and would need dozens of messages
fields.params_dir: root directory searched recursively for parameter-extraction runs, normally the same dataset root; only runs carrying both the extraction metadata and parameters.npy are offered
fields.param_run_filter: parameter-run paths relative to that root, as <dataset>/params/<run>; empty triggers interactive selection on a tty, else all runs
fields.param_required_paths: extraction outputs that must exist in a run, each a file or a directory whose whole subtree is attached; a missing one aborts that run loudly
fields.param_optional_paths: extraction outputs attached when present; a missing one only warns. The fitted arrays parameters.npy and fit_diagnostics.npz are deliberately absent from the default: together they run to tens of megabytes
fields.param_analysis_paths: outputs written by analyze_param_extraction, attached when present; when none of them exist the run has not been analysed and one warning names that entry
fields.staging_dir: directory that receives the gathered files, one subfolder per source; re-gathering overwrites the previous copies and deletes the archives of the previous run
fields.max_attachment_mb: upper bound of one archive in megabytes, measured on the uncompressed sources; a run, dataset or parameter run whose artifacts exceed it is split across as many messages as it needs, and a single file above it aborts loudly. Keep it under the mail server limit with room for the roughly one third that base64 encoding adds on the wire
fields.recipient: address every message is sent to
fields.sender: address the messages are sent from, also used as the SMTP login user
fields.smtp_host: SMTP server the messages are submitted to over SSL, defaults to smtp.gmail.com
fields.smtp_port: SSL port of the SMTP server, defaults to 465
fields.smtp_timeout_s: seconds a blocking SMTP connect, login or upload may stall before the submission fails with a timeout instead of hanging; each message logs its size before the submission and its duration after it, defaults to 300
fields.password_env: name of the environment variable holding the SMTP password (for Gmail, an app password); the password itself is never stored in the config, and an unset variable aborts a real send
fields.subject_prefix: prefix of every message subject, followed by a colon and the source label, and by the part number when a bundle is split across several messages
fields.dry_run: stage and log every message without opening an SMTP connection; needs no password and is the way to preview what would be sent

diagnostics::ReceptiveFieldConfig.summary: Entry config that measures the effective receptive field of one or more trained backbone runs on real data: probe pixels across the split region, gradient of the centre output magnitude w.r.t. the input window, ERF sigma per axis and a gradient-mass ladder, written into each run directory

fields.runs_dir: Root directory scanned recursively for run directories holding the configured checkpoint file; each selected run is measured in sequence
fields.run_filter: Run directory names (or names of parent directories whose nested runs are expanded) to measure; empty selects interactively on a TTY and every discovered run otherwise
fields.split: Dataset split whose region provides the real input stack the probes are cut from
fields.device: Torch device the model and probe windows run on; cpu is enough since only a handful of windows are evaluated
fields.checkpoint_name: Checkpoint filename loaded from each run directory and used as the run-discovery marker
fields.output_subdir: Name of the output directory created inside each run directory for the gradient cube, summary JSON, figures and markdown report
fields.window: Side length in pixels of the square probe window cut around each probe pixel; must fit inside the split region and bound all mass_windows
fields.n_row_probes: Number of probe pixels along row, spread evenly across the split region with a window/2 margin
fields.n_col_probes: Number of probe pixels along range, spread evenly across the split region with a window/2 margin
fields.mass_windows: Side lengths of the centred sub-windows the cumulative gradient-mass ladder is reported for; each must not exceed window
fields.figure_style: PlotBase figure style the ERF heatmap and mass curve are rendered with (report or paper)

diagnostics::ActivationXrayConfig.summary: Entry config that x-rays the activations of one or more trained backbone runs on real data: forward hooks on every leaf module over a few batches, issue detection for dead, exploding or constant activations, and a report per run

fields.runs_dir: Root directory scanned recursively for run directories holding the configured checkpoint file; each selected run is x-rayed in sequence
fields.run_filter: Run directory names (or names of parent directories whose nested runs are expanded) to x-ray; empty selects interactively on a TTY and every discovered run otherwise
fields.split: Dataset split the capture batches are drawn from
fields.device: Torch device the model and batches run on during capture
fields.checkpoint_name: Checkpoint filename loaded from each run directory and used as the run-discovery marker
fields.output_subdir: Name of the output directory created inside each run directory for the JSON dump, plots and markdown report
fields.batch_size: Batch size of the capture forward passes
fields.max_batches: Number of batches accumulated into the per-layer statistics; more batches sharpen dead-channel detection at linear cost
fields.dead_zero_frac_warn: Exact-zero activation fraction at or above which a layer is flagged as mostly dead (warning)
fields.dead_zero_frac_critical: Exact-zero activation fraction at or above which a layer is flagged as dead (critical)
fields.dead_channel_frac_warn: Fraction of channels that never activate above the dead threshold at or above which a layer is flagged (warning)
fields.explode_abs_threshold: Peak absolute activation at or above which a layer is flagged as exploding (warning)
fields.constant_std_threshold: Activation standard deviation at or below which a non-dead layer is flagged as constant (warning)
fields.make_plots: Render the depth-profile figures and per-layer histograms for flagged layers
fields.max_layer_histograms: Maximum number of flagged layers that get an individual activation histogram figure
fields.figure_style: PlotBase figure style the plots are rendered with (report or paper)
fields.channel_collapse_frac_warn: Effective channel fraction (entropy-effective channels over channel count) below which a layer is flagged as channel-collapsed (warning)

diagnostics::InputAttributionConfig.summary: Entry config that attributes the predictions of one or more trained backbone runs to their input channels via gradient attribution on probe windows and an optional channel-occlusion pass, written into each run directory

fields.runs_dir: Root directory scanned recursively for run directories holding the configured checkpoint file; each selected run is attributed in sequence
fields.run_filter: Run directory names (or names of parent directories whose nested runs are expanded) to attribute; empty selects interactively on a TTY and every discovered run otherwise
fields.split: Dataset split the probe windows and occlusion batches are drawn from
fields.device: Torch device the model runs on; cpu is enough for the handful of probe windows and batches
fields.checkpoint_name: Checkpoint filename loaded from each run directory and used as the run-discovery marker
fields.output_subdir: Name of the output directory created inside each run directory for the JSON, figures and markdown report
fields.window: Side length in pixels of the square probe window the gradients are computed over
fields.n_row_probes: Number of probe pixels along row, spread evenly across the split region with a window/2 margin
fields.n_col_probes: Number of probe pixels along range, spread evenly across the split region with a window/2 margin
fields.occlude: Also run the occlusion pass: zero one normalized input channel at a time over a few batches and measure the mean shift of the predicted profile against the unoccluded prediction
fields.batch_size: Batch size of the occlusion forward passes
fields.max_batches: Number of loader batches the occlusion deltas are averaged over; cost scales with channels x batches
fields.figure_style: PlotBase figure style the bar charts are rendered with (report or paper)

diagnostics::LayerProbeConfig.summary: Entry config that trains ridge linear probes on the intermediate features of one or more trained backbone runs, reporting held-out R² by depth for the GT active count and dominant component position along z, written into each run directory

fields.runs_dir: Root directory scanned recursively for run directories holding the configured checkpoint file; each selected run is probed in sequence
fields.run_filter: Run directory names (or names of parent directories whose nested runs are expanded) to probe; empty selects interactively on a TTY and every discovered run otherwise
fields.split: Dataset split the probe batches and sampled pixels are drawn from
fields.device: Torch device the model runs on during feature capture
fields.checkpoint_name: Checkpoint filename loaded from each run directory and used as the run-discovery marker
fields.output_subdir: Name of the output directory created inside each run directory for the JSON, depth figures and markdown report
fields.batch_size: Batch size of the capture forward passes
fields.max_batches: Number of loader batches whose activations feed the probes; more batches mean more probe samples at linear cost
fields.max_layers: Maximum number of leaf layers probed, spread evenly across the network depth
fields.samples_per_batch: Number of pixels sampled per batch as probe examples; features are read at each pixel's location scaled into every layer's spatial grid
fields.ridge_lambda: Ridge regularization strength of the linear probes
fields.seed: Seed of the sampled probe pixels and of the held-out probe split; vary it to check how sensitive the reported R² is to the sample
fields.figure_style: PlotBase figure style the decodability curves are rendered with (report or paper)
fields.n_folds: Number of cross-validation folds the ridge probe averages its held-out R² over

diagnostics::LossLandscapeConfig.summary: Entry config that maps the curve-MSE landscape around the trained weights of one or more backbone runs along two filter-normalized random directions, with 1D cuts, a 2D contour and sharpness scalars per run

fields.runs_dir: Root directory scanned recursively for run directories holding the configured checkpoint file; each selected run is mapped in sequence
fields.run_filter: Run directory names (or names of parent directories whose nested runs are expanded) to map; empty selects interactively on a TTY and every discovered run otherwise
fields.split: Dataset split the fixed evaluation batches are drawn from
fields.device: Torch device the perturbed model evaluations run on
fields.checkpoint_name: Checkpoint filename loaded from each run directory and used as the run-discovery marker
fields.output_subdir: Name of the output directory created inside each run directory for the JSON, figures and markdown report
fields.batch_size: Batch size of the fixed evaluation batches
fields.max_batches: Number of batches the curve MSE is averaged over at every grid point; total cost scales with n_points squared times batches
fields.span: Half-width of the sampled step range along each filter-normalized direction
fields.n_points_1d: Number of grid points of each 1D cut
fields.n_points_2d: Number of grid points per axis of the 2D contour; the grid costs n_points_2d squared evaluations
fields.direction_seed: Seed of the two random directions (seed and seed+1); fixed seeds make landscapes comparable across runs
fields.figure_style: PlotBase figure style the cuts and contour are rendered with (report or paper)
fields.n_directions: Number of filter-normalized random directions the 1-D cuts and sharpness statistics average over; the first two also span the 2-D grid

diagnostics::RobustnessConfig.summary: Entry config that stresses one or more trained backbone runs with controlled input degradation: curve MSE versus noise severity and versus number of dropped secondary channels, written into each run directory

fields.runs_dir: Root directory scanned recursively for run directories holding the configured checkpoint file; each selected run is stressed in sequence
fields.run_filter: Run directory names (or names of parent directories whose nested runs are expanded) to stress; empty selects interactively on a TTY and every discovered run otherwise
fields.split: Dataset split the fixed evaluation batches are drawn from
fields.device: Torch device the perturbed evaluations run on
fields.checkpoint_name: Checkpoint filename loaded from each run directory and used as the run-discovery marker
fields.output_subdir: Name of the output directory created inside each run directory for the JSON, curves and markdown report
fields.batch_size: Batch size of the fixed evaluation batches
fields.max_batches: Number of batches the curve MSE is averaged over at every severity level
fields.noise_sigmas: Gaussian noise standard deviations (in normalized input units) the degradation curve samples; include 0.0 for the clean reference
fields.draws_per_count: Number of random channel subsets averaged for each dropped-channel count
fields.seed: Seed of the noise draws and dropped-channel subsets
fields.figure_style: PlotBase figure style the severity curves are rendered with (report or paper)
fields.noise_draws: Number of independent noise draws averaged per sigma and channel scope; more draws tighten the error bars at linear cost
fields.gain_factors: Global input gain factors of the calibration-error sweep; 1.0 is always included as the reference
fields.shift_pixels: Row shifts in pixels of the shift-equivariance stress; each must stay below the patch height

diagnostics::TrainingEvolutionConfig.summary: Entry config that animates how one or more backbone runs learned: probe pixels re-predicted from every saved epoch snapshot, one GIF per pixel converging onto the fixed ground truth, written into each run directory

fields.runs_dir: Root directory scanned recursively for run directories holding the configured checkpoint file; each selected run is animated in sequence
fields.run_filter: Run directory names (or names of parent directories whose nested runs are expanded) to animate; empty selects interactively on a TTY and every discovered run otherwise
fields.split: Dataset split the probe windows are cut from
fields.device: Torch device the snapshot evaluations run on
fields.checkpoint_name: Checkpoint filename loaded from each run directory and used as the run-discovery marker; the model is restored to it after the sweep
fields.output_subdir: Name of the output directory created inside each run directory for the GIFs, JSON and markdown report
fields.window: Side length in pixels of the square window cut around each probe pixel for the forward passes
fields.n_row_probes: Number of probe pixels along row, spread evenly across the split region
fields.n_col_probes: Number of probe pixels along range, spread evenly across the split region
fields.fps: Frames per second of the rendered GIFs (one frame per epoch snapshot)
fields.figure_style: PlotBase figure style the frames are rendered with (report or paper)

diagnostics::OnnxExportEntryConfig.summary: Entry config that rebuilds each selected backbone run's model, loads its best checkpoint and exports the forward as an ONNX graph with a manifest

fields.runs_dir: root directory scanned recursively for runs holding a best_model.pt with backbone meta files; each becomes one export
fields.run_filter: substrings a run's relative name must contain to be exported; empty exports every discovered run
fields.opset: ONNX opset version the exported graph targets

diagnostics::ResultTableEntryConfig.summary: Entry config that exports one table row per run with finished inference: a CSV with every scalar metric plus LaTeX and markdown tables with the selected columns

fields.runs_dir: Root directory scanned recursively for runs holding a finished inference report; each selected run contributes figures

fields.metrics_filename: Filename marking a finished inference when resolving the latest stamp
fields.report_filename: Report filename used as the run-discovery marker
fields.figures_subdir: Name of the figures directory inside each inference stamp the patterns are matched against
fields.patterns: Glob patterns relative to the figures directory selecting which figures enter the pack
fields.output_dir: Publication figures directory the stable-named copies and the manifest are written into

fields.model_name: backbone registry key building the profiled workload; empty picks resunet
fields.gpu: index of the GPU the profiled steps execute on
fields.seed: random seed for sampling and model initialisation

synthesis::SynthesisConfig.summary: Generator settings for the bundled synthetic dataset: scene extent, z axis, mixture statistics, channel synthesis and output tags

fields.output_directory: Directory the generated dataset is written to, holding the data, meta and params subdirectories
fields.global_crop: Scene extent as (row_start, row_end, col_start, col_end) in pixels, recorded in the dataset layout so downstream splits address the same grid
fields.profile_length: Number of bins sampling the z axis of every rendered profile; must be at least 4
fields.z_range: Lower and upper bound of the z axis in z units, written to the dataset metadata and used to place every Gaussian
fields.k_max: Number of Gaussian slots generated per pixel, mirrored into the parameter run metadata as the K the models predict
fields.params_run_name: Name of the parameter run directory created under params/, referenced by the training path defaults
fields.primary_label: Label of the reference channel whose amplitude forms the primary input channel
fields.secondary_labels: Labels of the secondary channels, one amplitude channel and one derived channel each
fields.field_smoothing_pixels: Gaussian smoothing width in pixels applied to the random parameter fields, setting how slowly the scene varies spatially
fields.phase_smoothing_pixels: Gaussian smoothing width in pixels applied to the synthetic derived-channel phase fields
fields.amplitude_range: Lower and upper bound of the per-slot Gaussian amplitude drawn across the scene
fields.sigma_range: Lower and upper bound of the per-slot Gaussian width in z units; must be resolvable on the sampled z axis and no wider than half its span
fields.slot_band_margin: Fraction of the z span kept free at each end of a slot's band, so slot means stay separated and inside the axis
fields.empty_pixel_fraction: Fraction of pixels generated with no active Gaussian at all, giving the models genuine background
fields.dropped_slot_fraction: Fraction of the remaining pixels where one slot is switched off, so slot occupancy varies across the scene
fields.sensitivity_width_fraction: Width of the per-channel z sensitivity window as a fraction of the z span, deciding how much of a profile each channel sees
fields.channel_phase_rates: One phase rate per secondary channel, converting position along z into derived-channel phase; must list exactly as many entries as secondary_labels
fields.cube_noise_fraction: Relative noise added to the rendered profile volume, as a fraction of its scale
fields.channel_noise_fraction: Relative noise added to the synthesised primary, secondary and derived channels, as a fraction of their scale
fields.aux_range: Lower and upper bound of the smooth scalar field written as the auxiliary channel
fields.lambda_k: Model-order penalty recorded in the parameter run metadata, matching the field the extraction stage writes
fields.activity_threshold: Amplitude above which a generated slot counts as active, recorded in param_extraction_meta.json as the activity_threshold every training, inference and analysis stage reads for this dataset's labels
fields.threshold_factor: Relative profile threshold recorded in the parameter run metadata; zero because generated profiles need no pre-cleaning
fields.truncation_index: Z-axis truncation index recorded in the parameter run metadata for compatibility with the extraction stage
fields.dataset_type: Dataset type tag written into the dataset metadata
fields.cube_tag: Tag identifying the profile volume in the dataset metadata
fields.parameter_tag: Prefix of the generated parameter run, combined with params_run_name
fields.max_amplitude_clip: Upper clip applied to the synthesised channel amplitudes, recorded in the dataset metadata
fields.seed: Seed of the random generator, so a dataset is reproducible from its config alone

synthesis::GenerateDatasetEntryConfig.summary: Entry config that generates the bundled synthetic dataset in one run

fields.synthesis: Generator settings deciding the scene, the mixture statistics and the written artifacts
fields.log_dir: Directory the run log is written to
